stalls.summaryZh: 武聖排隊最長的攤位之一，麵包酥脆、餡料給得多，肉帶微咖哩香，價格便宜。
stalls.summaryEn: One of Wusheng's longest lines: crisp bread, generous filling, lightly curry-spiced meat and a low price.

sources.title: 兔兔安｜台南武聖夜市美食

stalls.summaryZh: 鐵板煎香腸與糯米腸分開吃，配料蒜頭、小黃瓜、醬油可自選，上過美食節目，排隊常態。
stalls.summaryEn: Griddle-fried sausage and sticky-rice sausage served separately with DIY toppings like garlic and cucumber. TV-featured, so lines are normal.

蕃薯藤旅遊｜台南夜市美食推薦

stalls.summaryZh: 三代經營的拔絲攤，糖衣甜脆，週六排隊可能要半小時左右。
stalls.summaryEn: A three-generation candied sweet potato stall with a sweet, crunchy coating; Saturday waits can reach about 30 minutes.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜8大台南夜市精選：營業時間表、必吃美食攻略
兔兔安｜台南武聖夜市美食

stalls.summaryZh: 古早味紅茶加鮮奶，甜度不膩，白色招牌好認；大東夜市也有出攤。
stalls.summaryEn: Old-style black tea with fresh milk, sweet but not cloying, with an easy-to-spot white sign. Also at Dadong.

sources.title: 蕃薯藤旅遊｜台南夜市美食推薦

stalls.summaryZh: 油看起來乾淨、外皮不焦、肉質嫩，排隊約15分鐘。
stalls.summaryEn: Clean-looking oil, skin that isn't burnt and tender meat; about a 15-minute queue.

sources.title: 兔兔安｜台南武聖夜市美食

stalls.summaryZh: 類似雞米花外酥內嫩，有多種調味粉，排隊約20分鐘；也會到其他夜市擺攤。
stalls.summaryEn: Popcorn-chicken style, crisp outside and soft inside, with several seasonings; around a 20-minute wait. Also rotates to other markets.

sources.title: 兔兔安｜台南武聖夜市美食

stalls.summaryZh: 木瓜味濃、CP值高，常見排隊人潮。
stalls.summaryEn: Strong papaya flavor and good value; there is usually a line.

sources.title: 兔兔安｜台南武聖夜市美食

stalls.summaryZh: 被列為初訪武聖的必吃攤位之一。
stalls.summaryEn: Listed as one of the must-try stalls for first-time Wusheng visitors.
